What this page opens with

Three metrics, and the first one is wrong in a way the page itself calls out. "Highest base €84.4k across all levels and scopes" is the maximum over intern, SDE1, SDE2 and senior AND over two different location scopes — printed two sections above copy promising figures are never blended across locations.

Then the whole monitoring block: last sync, fourteen role titles, four scans, a changelog. Operational detail, before a single salary.

The pay itself arrives around 1,000px down, as two tables split by location scope, with no way to say which level you are actually asking about.

One level, answered properly

The reference card's anatomy, in this app's language: pick a scope, then base as the dominant figure, total under it, and the components that make up the difference beside it — bonus and stock are columns EQ already has.

Scoping to one level is what fixes the blended number. €46.7k is Amazon at SDE1 in Madrid Metro, from Levels.fyi, checked 31 Aug — not a maximum taken across four levels and two scopes.

Under it the whole ladder, with the intern row marked as a different location scope rather than silently ranked among the rest, and the span drawn.

Monitoring drops to one card near the bottom: three numbers and a link, instead of fourteen role titles above the pay.
